cohort: Preterm infants less than 30 weeks gestation with respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) who initiated CPAP within 15 minutes after birth.
finding: FiO2 in the second hour of life (with a prognostic threshold of 0.29) is a significant predictor of CPAP failure within the first 72 hours, and infants who experience CPAP failure have a remarkably higher incidence of complications and mortality.
